text.text: I’m a new patient at Denver Dream Dentistry, and I’m so glad I made the switch! This office is modern, clean, and exceptionally well run. The staff is so nice, from the front desk to the dentists. They were efficient and really listened to my needs. Dr. Fucci takes a measured approach to fixing issues, which I greatly appreciate. My first visit was an exam and cleaning. I went back a week later to have a cracked filling repaired. They have a menu of options for patient comfort, which is a nice touch. I really liked the vibration tool he used while numbing my gums — I barely noticed the shot! Dr. Fucci was so fast. Afterward, they connected me to an electro-massaging tool to ease my TMJ. It’s now been a week and I haven’t had a single issue. My whole experience was wonderful. I will definitely be a customer for a long time. I’ve already referred several friends and family too!

text.text: So happy I found Denver Dream Dentistry. Everyone at this office is kind and welcoming, and I didn’t have to wait at all. Cloey was my hygienist and she was amazing. She walked me through the whole practice and took the time to explain everything she was doing (they have a lot of tech I’ve never seen before). Best of all, nothing hurt. Dr. Baranes was very nice and went over everything with me at the end. Overall just a really great experience.

text.text: I had a great experience at the dentist today! From the moment I walked in the door until I left, everyone was welcoming, professional, and friendly. My dental hygienist, Chloe, was thorough, gentle, and made the entire cleaning comfortable, and Dr. Fucci was excellent as always. I truly appreciate the quality of care and attention they provide. I’m grateful to have such an outstanding dental practice right here in my neighborhood. Highly recommend!

text.text: I had an exceptional experience at Denver Dream Dentistry today. Everyone made me feel welcome and comfortable from start to finish. I had a 2 crown procedure done. Dr. Fucci and his assistant Herbert worked together with precision and gentleness, giving me breaks throughout my procedure. My crowns were made in the office, fit perfectly, and look amazing. Thank you for taking such great care of me—I highly recommend Denver Dream Dentistry!

text.text: I have been going to this office for over 10 years. Dr. Downs created a really unique and patient-focused environment that kept me coming back…and he chose the perfect successor in Dr. Baranes. Highly, highly recommended. But special shout out to Hien. She’s been there through the changes, remembers your name, and has been the face of this office for me for years. Wonderful human, skilled professional, and the perfect person to represent this kind of company culture.
